title: The Sunken Citadel (Interactive Story)
note: Original synthetic fixture for interactive branching stories (passages, choices, conditions).

blocks.x:
You stand before the obsidian archway of the Sunken Citadel. Sea foam coats the mossy flagstones.

[[Enter through the Grand Portico -> Portico]]
[[Scramble along the Sea Wall -> SeaWall]]

Massive bronze doors hang half-open, encrusted with barnacles. A glowing pedestal stands in the foyer.

[[Inspect the pedestal -> Pedestal]]
[[Return to the entrance -> Start]]

Salt spray blinds you as waves batter the rocky footing. You spot a narrow drainage conduit leading inward.

[[Crawl through the conduit -> CitadelDepths]]
[[Return to the entrance -> Start]]

A silver ring rests in a pool of clear water atop the marble pedestal.

[[Take the ring and proceed -> CitadelDepths [if ring_taken]]]
[[Leave the ring and turn back -> Portico]]

You reach the heart of the ancient citadel. Bioluminescent coral illuminates the submerged throne room.

[THE END]
